author: TEDx Talks
description:
Dr Jake Renzella reveals how AI-driven misinformation campaigns shape our digital landscape, from nation-states to special-interest groups manipulating elections and narratives. Discover why social media platforms profit from bot activity and what you can do to reclaim truth. 

Dr Jake Renzella. Senior Lecturer in CSE at UNSW, Co-Head of the Computing and Education research group, and Director of Studies in Computer Science, Dr Renzella has a lot to offer when it comes to computers, AI, and education. 

Much of his research focuses on the fields of Pedagogical Generative AI and education technology. He has also built complex open source education technologies & is passionate about aligning AI technology with current Australian curriculums. 

This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: How AI and social media are destroying the internet | Jake Renzella | TEDxUNSW

author: TEDx Talks
description:
English, Math(s), Science....  yes personal finance.... no Samantha Kaye guides us through the mine field of personal finance, certainly something that has never been taught in school! Samantha Kaye is a Chartered Financial Adviser and Fellow of the Personal Finance Society. Passionate about financial education, she helps individuals and families make informed decisions that create confidence, security and long-term wellbeing.

Through her work, Samantha champions practical life skills and financial literacy, believing that everyone deserves access to the knowledge needed to make better decisions for their future. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: What they didn't teach you in school | Samantha Kaye | TEDxCrawley

author: TEDx Talks
description:
When we look at vulnerable communities or regions like Northeast Nigeria, what do we usually see? Headlines often reduce people to their suffering—hunger, displacement, poverty, and a lack of resources.

In this moving TEDx talk, Dr. Benjamin John shares a transformative encounter with a malnourished child in Dikwa in 2018 that reshaped their understanding of aid and development. Challenging the habit of viewing communities merely as passive recipients of charity, the talk reveals how vulnerability does not erase capability, resilience, or local knowledge.

Discover why lasting change requires shifting our mindset from "What can we do for this community?" to "What can we build with them?"—fostering true partnership, ownership, and sustainable impact. Benjamin John is a development and humanitarian professional focused on improving the lives of vulnerable and crisis-affected communities, particularly in Northeast Nigeria.

His work spans education, protection, livelihoods, health, peac
title: What We Miss When We Only See Poverty | Benjamin John | TEDxJimeta

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this inspiring TEDx Talk, Sanju Thakran, Founder and Director of Thakur Logistic Park, shares his remarkable journey of entering the logistics and real estate industry at just 22, despite having no prior experience or family business background in the sector. After facing startup failures during COVID-19, he returned to India with a clear vision, overcame criticism and industry challenges, and worked towards building successful business projects through determination, continuous learning, and self-belief.
Through his journey, Sanju delivers a powerful message to young entrepreneurs and aspiring leaders: “Turn Your Problems into Fuel.” He highlights the importance of believing in yourself before others do, staying focused on your vision, and treating obstacles as opportunities for growth. His talk reminds us that success is not simply about luck, but about consistent effort, resilience, and the courage to pursue what others may consider impossible. Sanju Thakran is a real estate and
title: Development In Real Estate | Sanju Thakran | TEDxSGU

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Negli ultimi vent’anni Barbara Serra ha vissuto dall’interno una doppia rivoluzione del giornalismo. Nel 2006 è tra i giornalisti che lanciano Al Jazeera English, il canale che segna la fine del monopolio occidentale sull’informazione globale. Lo stesso anno Facebook si apre a tutti, dando il via all’era digitale dell’informazione. Se il motto di Al Jazeera era “la voce di chi non ha voce”, i social hanno dato voce a tutti. L’algoritmo sta sostituendo la scaletta del TG e i telespettatori sono diventati followers. Vent’anni dopo, Barbara Serra porta sul palco di TEDx Sassari una domanda fondamentale: siamo davvero meglio informati? Chi fa luce sul mondo? Giornalista, documentarista e scrittrice, Barbara Serra ha lavorato tra BBC, Al Jazeera English e Sky News UK, raccontando il mondo dall’Europa, dal Medio Oriente e da Washington. È stata la prima giornalista non madrelingua inglese a condurre un telegiornale in prima serata sulla televisione britannica.
Nel 2020 realizza Fascism in t
title: Oltre Al Jazeera: dal telegiornale al feed. Chi fa luce sul mondo? | Barbara Serra | TEDxSassari

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Imagine walking past a pile of coconut shells. What do you see? Most people would probably see waste. Now imagine seeing a river filled with dirty water. What do you see? A problem. But what if, instead of seeing them as two separate problems, we ask “Could one problem become part of the solution to another?” That was the question that changed the way I see the world.
 Azkia was born on 23 August 2011. Azkia is a Grade 10 student from Cahaya Rancamaya
who enjoys learning new things, especially science and environmental research. She is
interested in exploring new ideas, gaining different perspectives, and finding creative
solutions to real-world problems. Through her participation in TEDx, Azkia hopes to share
her ideas with others, inspire meaningful discussions, and encourage people to think beyond
the ordinary. She believes that even small ideas can grow into something meaningful and

title: What can I do? | Annisa Azkia Suryadi | TEDxCRIBS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Mentalist and illusionist Sapan Joshi takes us behind the seemingly impossible moments audiences witness on stage. Drawing on two decades of experience, he reveals the countless hours of practice, failure, observation and correction hidden behind a few effortless seconds. The talk reminds us that extraordinary achievement is rarely the result of talent alone—it is built through persistence, learning from mistakes and continuing even when we are not yet good. Sapan Joshi is a mentalist, illusionist and psychological entertainer with over 20 years of experience creating experiences that explore perception, psychology and the mysteries of the human mind. His performances blend psychology, observation and suggestion with sophisticated entertainment, inviting audiences to question how they perceive, decide and interpret reality. Over his career, Sapan has performed at 1,500+ events across 10+ countries, entertaining audiences in India and internationally. His work has also taken him to eve
title: The Hours Behind the Seconds | Mr. Sapan Joshi | TEDxJGIS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Through defining moments from her personal and professional journey, Dr. Sudipti Arora explores the power of asking, “Why not?” She shows how keeping possibility open can help us face uncertainty, challenge perceived limitations and take meaningful action. The talk is not about blind optimism, but about combining hope with effort, resilience and the willingness to try again. Dr. Sudipti Arora is an Environmental Research Scientist, sustainability leader and entrepreneur working at the intersection of science, climate action and societal impact. A PhD in Environmental Engineering from IIT Roorkee, she is Director–Research & Innovation at Dr. B. Lal Institute of Biotechnology and Founder-Director of Prakrit Sustainable Integrated Foundation and Prakrit Innovations. Her work spans water and wastewater management, circular economy, zero-waste and net-zero models, climate resilience and ESG. She has led nationally funded rural transformation initiatives, including the Aandhi Zero-Waste Vil
title: Why Not? The Question That Changes Everything | Dr. Sudipti Arora | TEDxJGIS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: In a world that often pressures people to specialise early, Abhinav Singh Kaurav presents a different possibility. Drawing from his experience across varied interests and disciplines, he explains how seemingly unrelated skills can strengthen one another. His talk encourages young people to explore widely, develop selected areas deeply and create an identity that is not limited to a single label. Abhinav Singh Kaurav is a singer-songwriter, composer, storyteller, writer, speaker, content creator and IT professional who blends creativity and technology. A Civil Engineering graduate, he works as a Lead Database Administrator while pursuing music and storytelling. He created “Abhi Ki Duniya,” a houseful musical storytelling show combining narrative theatre, original live music and visuals. His debut album, “Pehal,” features his original compositions. He has performed at several prestigious institutions and platforms, including TEDx events, college festivals, concerts and independent shows
title: Jack of All Trades, Master of Some | Mr. Abhinav Singh Kaurav | TEDxJGIS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Courage does not always arrive before action. Sometimes it develops only after we take the first uncertain step. Drawing on her experiences in television and her decision to leave professional security to build something new, Uma Oza explores how responsible risk-taking, preparation and action can transform fear into confidence and personal growth. Uma Oza is a thought leader in education and human development with over four decades of experience transforming how individuals and institutions learn, lead and evolve. Her work integrates Nonviolent Communication into leadership and learning, fostering cultures rooted in trust, empathy and conscious responsibility. She has pursued advanced studies in Teaching for Understanding and Coaching for Understanding at Harvard University and is a certified facilitator of The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People and Theatre of the Oppressed. She also holds an international certification in Theme-Centred Interaction from the Ruth Cohn Institute, Berl
title: Between “I Don’t Know” and “Let Me Try” | Ms. Uma Oza | TEDxJGIS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Disasters test more than infrastructure—they reveal how people, institutions and communities respond when familiar systems collapse. Drawing from her experience in disaster resilience, Dr. Prerna Singh challenges the idea that resilience simply means returning to the way things were. She explains why meaningful recovery requires preparedness, adaptability, collaboration and the courage to build better pathways for the future. Dr. Prerna Singh is an infrastructure resilience and climate adaptation specialist whose work bridges research, policy and real-world implementation. With an academic background in Civil Engineering, including a PhD and MS from Georgia Institute of Technology and a BTech from IIT Gandhinagar, she has worked across academia, international development and resilience-focused organisations. Her professional journey includes work connected with UNDP, the Asian Disaster Preparedness Center and the Adaptation Research Alliance Infrastructure, along with leadership in cl
title: Beyond Bouncing Back: What Disasters Teach Us About Resilience | Dr. Prerna Singh | TEDxJGIS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
I think most of us want to be good at what we do. We want good results. We want people to be proud of us. And, sometimes, we want to be perfect. But I learned something when I failed: Trying to be perfect can stop us from growing. So, never be afraid of failure. Never be afraid of making mistakes, and don't wait until you are perfect before you try to make a difference. Start with yourself. Because sometimes, becoming a better version of yourself is the first step towards creating a better world.
 Medina is a 10-Grader at Cahaya Rancamaya Islamic Boarding School. She has reading comics, solving toy-puzzles such as LEGO, Gundams and listening to music as her hobbies. She wants to explain her feelings through speaking in public—to let everyone know that what she’s interested in aren’t only ordinary activities. By participating as a TEDx speaker, she hopes that one day she can actually speak up about her things. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but inde

Personal growth is a key factor for our generation, because when you discover the world of self discovery, you always find new positive activities, people who have become a brave person volunteer in youth associations , participate in youth programs, they join a debating community to self reflect themselves to be a better individual, and most importantly, they contribute to making an impact. Please remember that when you find the right community, you find yourself.

title: Beyond the Blueprint | Aisha Aila Rafani | TEDxCRIBS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if better health begins long before a crisis? Drawing from her personal experiences as a mother and public health leader, Dr. Krystal Redman challenges us to rethink how we build healthier communities. She explores why lasting health depends not only on systems that respond to emergencies, but on the relationships, resources, and support structures we create before they happen. Dr. Krystal Redman, DrPH, MHA, is a public health leader, strategist, author, speaker, and community builder working at the intersection of reproductive justice, Health Justice, public health, and liberation. Their work spans executive leadership, community organizing, public health strategy, and movement building, advancing community-driven solutions rooted in justice, bodily autonomy, and collective well-being.

Rooted in a legacy of Black liberation organizing, Dr. Redman examines how anti-Blackness, white supremacy, colonialism, and capitalism shape health and life opportunities for marginalized commun
title: By the Time the System Responds, It's Already Too Late | Dr. Krystal Redman | TEDxBuckheadAve

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Confidence doesn’t mean never doubting yourself, but it means not letting that doubt erase what you have accomplished. So next time you think, “I was just lucky,” remember the effort, the mistakes, and the times you kept going. Because luck can be part of your story. But your effort is part of it too. So just be proud of how far you've come, even if you're still figuring out where you're going.
 Nashwa is an eighth-grade student in Cahaya Rancamaya IBS who likes trying something new or even achieving it. But fun fact, she sometimes felt like an impostor despite her own success. But then,
she took a step back, did some self-reflection and stopped letting that doubt annoy her. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: I Thought I Was Just Lucky | Nashwa Zaidarahman | TEDxCRIBS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
How can we learn to see existing things in a new light? Neerja Palisetty explores how a fresh perspective, persistence, belief in our dreams, and the blessings of our elders can help transform ideas into reality. Her talk invites us to look beyond the familiar and discover the possiblities hidden in everyday things.  Neerja Palisetty is the founder of Sutrakaar Creations, a design studio rooted in sustainability, craft, & innovation. With more than 24 years of experience across the textile industry & education sector, she has led groundbreaking work in hand-woven paper textiles, taking them
from concept to recognition in India and abroad. Her work centers on reviving traditional techniques, supporting artisan communities, & creating eco-conscious design solutions. Her efforts have been featured in several national & international publications.
She studied Clothing & Textiles at The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda and has built her professional career around textile design, edu
title: Seeing existing things in a new light | Neerja Palisetty | TEDxMayoor School Ajmer

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Krish Bhawrani explores how true growth comes not simply from doing things repeatedly, but from learning from past mistakes and experiences. His talk highlights that becoming better does not always require learning something entirely new; sometimes, it begins with reflecting on what went wrong and using those lessons to improve.  Krish Bhawrani is an entrepreneur associated with JODYHUB and is currently pursuing his education at Maharshi Dayanand University. His professional journey is at an early stage, with his work currently centred around entrepreneurship and building within the startup and business ecosystem.
An alumnus of Mayoor School, Ajmer, Krish Bhawrani is a digital content creator and entrepreneur, and Co-founder of JodyHub. His 365-day content challenge built a huge audience for JodyHub which now ships 200+ orders daily.

As a young entrepreneur, his professional journey offers a perspective on building ideas and exploring opportunities in today's rapidly changing busines
title: Consistency without learning is mere repetition | Krish Bhawrani | TEDxMayoor School Ajmer

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Rejection is not the end of the journey; it can be the beginning of growth. Gaurav Dagaonkar explores how to deal with rejection, embrace it as a learning opportunity, and remain grateful for the setbacks we encounter. His talk reminds us that success is rarely achieved overnight and that every successful person has climbed the ladder of achievement by overcoming numerous rejections along the way.  Gaurav Dagaonkar is a musician, singer-songwriter, music producer and entrepreneur. He is the Co-founder and CEO of Hoopr.ai, a music-licensing platform serving content creators and businesses.

An alumnus of IIM Ahmedabad, Gaurav chose to pursue a career in music after completing his MBA. He has worked as a singer, composer and producer and is known for songs including College Days and Main Dhoondne Ko Zamaane Mein, as well as his music mashups. He has also worked with artists including Arijit Singh, Shreya Ghoshal, Mohit Chauhan, KK and Rahat Fateh Ali Khan.

In 2018, he co-founded GSharp
title: Be Grateful For Every Rejection You Receive | Gaurav Dagaonkar | TEDxMayoor School Ajmer

author: TEDx Talks
description: In his speech he seamlessly blends humour with deep patriotism. Transitioning effortlessly from lighthearted, funny past stories of his early failures, military blunders, and personal quirks, he shifts into a profoundly moving tribute to the men and women in uniform. By highlighting the silent sacrifices, unwavering moral courage, and unparalleled resilience of the Armed Forces. Major Mohammed Ali Shah is a distinguished Indian Army veteran, international motivational speaker, and accomplished film actor who seamlessly bridged the gap between military precision and creative expression. After serving his country with honor, he channeled his leadership skills into the corporate and entertainment worlds, becoming one of the most prolific TEDx speakers globally. As a high-profile television defense analyst, he provides sharp, strategic insights on national security, while his work as an actor across various films and theatre productions showcases his deep versatility and dedication to art

author: TEDx Talks
description: This talk explores the growing challenge of misinformation and disinformation in the digital age, highlighting why internet access alone is not enough without the ability to question, verify, and critically evaluate information. Drawing from media experience in Borno State, the speaker examines how false information can fuel fear, undermine public trust, and disrupt peacebuilding efforts. The talk introduces the PAUSE framework—Pause, Ask, Understand yourself, Seek other perspectives, and evaluate before you amplify—as a practical approach to responsible digital engagement, informed decision-making, and building a more trusting society Muhammed Usman is a media executive, broadcaster, communications strategist, and public speaker with over a decade of experience in journalism, broadcasting, and digital communication. author: TEDx Talks
description: She explores the vital intersection of clinical psychology, state law, and women's safety. Drawing directly from her foundational work training thousands of police personnel and counseling emergency response units like Uttar Pradesh's Women Power Line 1090, Dr. Anand shifts the conversation from passive protection to psychological fortitude. She breaks down the internal anatomy of trauma, challenges institutional biases within law enforcement, and maps out a roadmap for legal frameworks to become genuinely survivor-centric. Ultimately, her speech serves as an urgent call to action—proving that true female empowerment requires reforming both the system's mindset and the structural laws that govern it. Dr. Neha Anand is a highly respected counseling psychologist, psychotherapist, and mental health advocate who has dedicated her career to fostering psychological well-being across diverse communities. As the founder-director of Bodhitree India, she has created a safe space for mental heal

author: TEDx Talks
description: Demystifying the internal mechanics of modern AI models, Kushal shifts the conversation from blind dependency to tactical collaboration. He addresses the vital trap of "AI hallucination" and structural bias, presenting an urgent case for why professionals must rigorously validate data, audit outputs, and avoid making high-stakes decisions based entirely on unverified AI answers. Rather than treating AI as an infallible decision-maker or an absolute replacement for human thought, Kushal outlines how to treat it as an exceptionally fast, token-efficient co-pilot. He leaves developers, tech professionals, and students with an actionable blueprint on how to sharpen their independent, critical thinking while leveraging AI tools strategically to accelerate productivity and amplify their own engineering potential. Kushal Vijay is a prominent software engineer, AI specialist, and tech educator who has built a massive community of developers across social media. An alumnus of NIT Jalandhar and
title: Balancing Human Intent with Artificial Intelligence | Kushal Vijay | TEDxIntegral University

author: TEDx Talks
description:
How often do we hide behind the noise of a digital screen to escape what we are actually feeling?Viquar Haider Khan weaves an intimate narrative about the human condition, vulnerability, and resilience. Intersecting his personal journey, corporate milestones, and nostalgic childhood stories, Viquar delivers a poignant reflection on life's cyclical nature—detailing the raw, uncomfortable truths of how people fall apart, adapt, and ultimately rise again.
Infusing the talk with soul-stirring Urdu poetry (shayari), he issues a gentle but urgent plea to establish healthy boundaries with our mobile devices. He leaves the audience with a profound realization that in a world consumed by digital noise, intentional silence is not a void—it is our greatest asset. Viquar Haider Khan is a prominent digital creator, author, and bilingual poet who seamlessly weaves human emotion into resonant verses in both Urdu and English. With a growing digital footprint, he has revived a love for classical poeti
title: The Sound of Silence: Reclaiming Contentment | Viquar Haider Khan | TEDxIntegral University

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In a world that celebrates strength and perseverance, what happens when resilience becomes a burden? Fatima challenges the belief that being resilient means constantly pushing through adversity, suppressing emotions, and remaining strong at all costs.

Drawing attention to the often-overlooked psychological toll of excessive resilience, she explores the importance of recognising personal limits, embracing vulnerability, and prioritising mental well-being. She advocates for greater mental health awareness, community-level education, and breaking the stigma surrounding anxiety, trauma, and emotional struggles.

Through her talk, Fatima invites us to rethink resilience, not as the ability to endure endlessly, but as the wisdom to know when to pause, seek support, adapt, and heal. Fatima Ibrahim Musa is a legal practitioner, development specialist, social justice advocate, and entrepreneur with over a decade of experience in justice reform, gender inclusion, and human rights advocacy in N
title: The Hidden Cost of Being Unbreakable | Fatima Ibrahim Musa | TEDxMaiduguri

author: TEDx Talks
description: Crucially, Maroof turns his personal playbook into a concrete guide for the audience on how they can start their own creative journeys. He provides an intimate blueprint on how to look beyond the obvious, turn a creative passion into a self-sustaining system, and bridge the gap between niche authenticity and mainstream commercial success—proving that the extraordinary is always hidden just beneath the surface of the ordinary. Maroof Umar, widely known by his popular digital pseudonym Maroof Culmen, is a visionary visual storyteller, architectural documentarian, and creative director based in Uttar Pradesh. He has committed his creative life to the cultural preservation of Lucknow's rich, fading heritage. Through breathtaking photography, documentary filmmaking, and curation, Maroof meticulously captures the city's intricate Awadhi architecture, archives its dying traditional crafts, and shines a spotlight on the historic, ancient Nanbai culinary arts that define the true essence of th

author: TEDx Talks
description: Reflecting on nearly two decades in the entertainment industry, Alam breaks down the glamorous illusion of overnight stardom, revealing that long-term success is built entirely in the shadows of rejection, persistence, and continuous self-improvement. Turning his personal playbook into a masterclass for students and young creators, he discusses why talent is only the starting point. He emphasizes that true growth requires unwavering daily discipline and the consistency to show up even when motivation fades, offering students a powerful blueprint for turning raw ambition into a lasting, impactful reality. Alam Khan is a prominent Indian actor, dancer, and model who rose to prominence as a versatile child artist before transitioning into mainstream web series and cinema. Born on June 19, 1999, in Shahjahanpur, Uttar Pradesh, he initially garnered widespread attention through televised dance reality shows, finishing as the first runner-up in Chhote Miyan (2012) and performing on Chak Dho
title: The Acting Journey & Youth Inspiration | Alam Khan | TEDxIntegral University

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this thought-provoking talk, the speaker challenges our tendency to manage the consequences of problems rather than confront their underlying causes. From social challenges and development interventions to public policies and everyday decisions, we have become increasingly comfortable treating symptoms while leaving the systems and conditions that produce them unchanged.

The talk explores how short-term solutions, reactive thinking, and misplaced priorities often create the illusion of progress without delivering meaningful change. It calls for a shift from managing crises to preventing them, from measuring activities to evaluating outcomes, and from temporary fixes to lasting solutions.

At its heart is a simple but powerful argument: Real progress begins when we stop asking how to manage a problem and start questioning why it exists in the first place. Mabruka Maina is a final-year Doctor of Veterinary Medicine student at the University of Maiduguri and a force for grassroots tr
title: Beyond the Symptoms: Are We Really Solving Problems? | Mabruka Maina | TEDxMaiduguri
